reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    Topic: South Carolina eviction/ejectment appeals and stays of execution (focus year 2021)
    Question: For eviction proceedings, does a tenant have to request a stay of execution for an appeal?
*/

/* =========================
   Scenario (question facts)
   ========================= */

% The user-provided jurisdiction and year.
scenario_state(south_carolina).
scenario_year(2021).

% The proceeding is an eviction/ejectment (magistrates' court ejectment is the typical summary eviction).
scenario_proceeding(ejectment).

% The tenant is appealing the ejectment judgment.
scenario_tenant_is_appealing(true).

/* Helper predicate that succeeds when the encoded factual scenario is satisfied. */
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(south_carolina),
    scenario_year(2021),
    scenario_proceeding(ejectment),
    scenario_tenant_is_appealing(true).

/* =========================
   Statute translations
   ========================= */

% --- SC Code  27-37-130 (2021) ---
% "An appeal in an ejectment case will not stay ejectment unless ... tenant shall give an appeal bond ..."
statute_sc_27_37_130_appeal_does_not_stay_ejectment(Year) :-
    Year =:= 2021.

% The condition for a stay under  27-37-130: tenant gives an appeal bond at the time of appealing.
statute_sc_27_37_130_stay_condition(Year, condition(appeal_bond_given_at_time_of_appeal)) :-
    Year =:= 2021.

% "If tenant fails to file the bond ... within five days after service of notice of appeal such appeal shall be dismissed"
statute_sc_27_37_130_bond_deadline_days_after_notice(Year, 5) :-
    Year =:= 2021.

statute_sc_27_37_130_appeal_dismissed_if_bond_not_filed_within_deadline(Year) :-
    statute_sc_27_37_130_bond_deadline_days_after_notice(Year, Days),
    Days =:= 5.

% --- SC Code  27-40-800 (2021) ---
% (b) "It is sufficient to stay execution ... that the tenant sign an undertaking ... Any magistrate, clerk,
% or circuit court judge shall order a stay of execution upon the undertaking."
statute_sc_27_40_800_stay_sufficient_condition(Year, condition(tenant_signs_rent_undertaking)) :-
    Year =:= 2021.

statute_sc_27_40_800_authority_must_order_stay_upon_undertaking(Year) :-
    Year =:= 2021.

% (e) Failure to pay within five days of due date per undertaking allows landlord to dissolve stay, etc.
statute_sc_27_40_800_payment_grace_days(Year, 5) :-
    Year =:= 2021.

/* =========================
   Legal reasoning helpers
   ========================= */

% In SC (2021), for ejectment, an appeal alone does not automatically stay execution/ejectment.
legal_no_automatic_stay_on_appeal(State, Year, ejectment) :-
    State == south_carolina,
    statute_sc_27_37_130_appeal_does_not_stay_ejectment(Year).

% In SC (2021), a stay of execution pending appeal requires an affirmative tenant act:
% either giving an appeal bond ( 27-37-130) or signing an undertaking ( 27-40-800).
legal_stay_requires_affirmative_tenant_step(State, Year, ejectment) :-
    State == south_carolina,
    Year =:= 2021,
    ( statute_sc_27_37_130_stay_condition(Year, condition(appeal_bond_given_at_time_of_appeal))
    ; statute_sc_27_40_800_stay_sufficient_condition(Year, condition(tenant_signs_rent_undertaking))
    ).

% We interpret "request a stay" in this QA as: the tenant must take some affirmative step to obtain a stay;
% it is not automatic merely because an appeal is filed.
legal_tenant_must_request_or_obtain_stay_for_appeal(State, Year, Proceeding) :-
    legal_no_automatic_stay_on_appeal(State, Year, Proceeding),
    legal_stay_requires_affirmative_tenant_step(State, Year, Proceeding).

/* =========================
   Answer predicate
   ========================= */

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    scenario_state(State),
    scenario_year(Year),
    scenario_proceeding(Proceeding),
    scenario_tenant_is_appealing(true),
    legal_tenant_must_request_or_obtain_stay_for_appeal(State, Year, Proceeding),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    !.

/* =========================
   Main entrypoint
   ========================= */

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: For eviction proceedings, does a tenant have to request a stay of execution for an appeal?
